end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines.
Used examples including stumps, a boundary, a ladder, and a flagpole.
Identified 4 of 6 examples correctly without help.
Discussed that a tilted line can still be straight; this was corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping, and slanting lines with examples from everyday objects. Om used the direction of a line to identify standing and sleeping lines, and later explained that standing and slanting lines can both be straight. Om initially mixed up a tilted line with a curved line, but corrected this later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to sort pencils or drawn lines into standing, sleeping, and slanting groups, checking whether each line bends.
